policy_divergences.finding: The source's Driver Policy 4.2 makes a failure to notify the rider render the driver liable for the excess fare.
policy_divergences.source_policy: traffic_analysis.policy_reference: 'Drivers must inform the rider of any route deviation ... Failure to notify renders the driver liable for excess fare charges attributable to the unnotified deviation.'
policy_divergences.this_system: POL-RD-24 states the remedy as a matrix: a traffic-justified reroute the rider was not informed of refunds the excess distance fare (row (b)), and one that is not traffic-justified refunds it in full (row (d)). The source's rule reaches the same figure for row (b).
policy_divergences.effect: The converted case carries no remedy. POL-RD-24 is read from the loaded policy at arbitration time, and the money block publishes the excess distance fare the clause computes.

policy_divergences.finding: The source states the excess distance fare itself, and it does not equal the deviation times the rate it also states.
policy_divergences.source_policy: fare_breakdown.excess_distance_fare: 3.44, from a deviation the source gives as 4.3 km and a rate its note gives as $0.80/km, which multiply to 3.44.
policy_divergences.this_system: POL-RD-24 computes the excess distance fare as the deviation distance times fare_breakdown.per_km_rate_sgd, to the cent. 4.30 x 0.80 is 3.44, so the source's own figure and this system's arithmetic agree on this case.
policy_divergences.effect: The converted case carries the rate and the two distances, and the money block computes the fare. The source's own figure is not carried beside it, because two answers to one question is one too many.

policy_divergences.this_system: This corpus's dispute ids are DSP-<case_no>, its category token is ROUTE_DEVIATION, and it has no 'status', 'priority' or 'assigned_to' key.
policy_divergences.effect: dispute_id is carried unchanged as DISP-001, so the converted case can be traced back to the organisers' document; the four workflow fields are dropped and the drops are recorded.

policy_divergences.effect: Each type travels upper-cased exactly as the source states it, so the reading of whether it is a kind POL-RD-23 names can be made from the record rather than decided by the conversion.
